milestones.title: Architecture and Rust-only feasibility spikes
acceptance_criteria: Compare chunked typed tables against a generic ECS candidate using load, traversal, small/wide edit and branch workloads.
Validate radial-handle topology with loose, non-manifold and degenerate test data.
Generate intersection and scattering GPU kernels from Rust-owned definitions; execute in native and browser hosts.
Prototype native/browser durable storage with interrupted writes.
Audit enabled dependencies and native runtime links.
milestones.estimate_policy: Estimate only after relevant prototype and staffing evidence.
milestones.completion_scope: Measured typed/flat/hecs scene storage and radial/dense/manifold admissibility; generated transport kernels; native/browser storage faults; dependency audit and accepted foundation ADRs.

milestones.title: Document and geometry core
acceptance_criteria: Persistent IDs survive rename, reparent and save/reload.
Instances share versioned geometry assets without accidental realization.
Native/WASM fixtures preserve UV seams, loose geometry, n-gons and supported non-manifold structure.
Revision/branch behavior shares unchanged chunks.
Invalid indices, attribute lengths, reference cycles and inverse-requiring singular operations are rejected with typed errors.
milestones.estimate_policy: Estimate only after relevant prototype and staffing evidence.
milestones.completion_scope: Typed immutable document/geometry v0; planar simple polygons, dense typed attributes, f32/f64 positions, shared geometry, ordered/affine transforms, sparse override layers, native binary mesh roots.

milestones.title: Transactions, API/ABI alpha and durable jobs
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate live idempotency keys with equal payload return one accepted result.
Different payload with the same live key is rejected.
Stale/conflicting writes cannot partially modify committed state.
Crash injection recovers the last valid advertised durable root.
In-process and wire clients produce equivalent accepted deltas.
Jobs/events support bounded queues, resumable event cursors and explicit cancellation states.
milestones.estimate_policy: Estimate only after relevant prototype and staffing evidence.
milestones.completion_scope: Trusted local transaction and wire clients; bounded uploads/jobs/events; native durable job host and recovery; independently exercised memory-only ABI alpha v0. No ABI v1 or remote multi-tenant service.

milestones.title: CPU renderer and initial native interchange
acceptance_criteria: Render a scene constructed entirely through the native API with no Blender/Cycles process or library.
Validate camera, triangle/BVH, instance, surface, lighting, texture and color behavior.
Run analytic, energy, PDF and statistical image tests.
Export a render receipt with immutable input/version/seed metadata.
Round-trip declared static glTF/OBJ subsets with explicit loss reports.
milestones.estimate_policy: Estimate only after relevant prototype and staffing evidence.
milestones.completion_scope: CPU Lambertian/point-light/constant-environment/nearest-texture renderer with bounded finite depth, analytic tests and image/pass receipts; scoped OBJ and glTF static mesh-only codecs.

milestones.title: Portable GPU renderer and browser-local execution
acceptance_criteria: Rust-authored kernels execute on a native GPU and browser WebGPU target.
Software GPU traversal works without hardware ray-query requirements.
Matched CPU/GPU and independent analytic tests meet their declared numerical/statistical tolerances.
Progressive render and preview respect negotiated resource profiles.
Device loss, allocation failure and cancellation do not corrupt authored revisions.
milestones.estimate_policy: Estimate only after relevant prototype and staffing evidence.
milestones.completion_scope: One-bounce GPU diffuse profile, software BVH traversal, progressive batches and approximate raster; Metal and browser WebGPU including worker; pre/post-submit cancellation, over-limit allocation and explicit device destroy/recreate.

milestones.title: Agent-rendering alpha and narrow ABI v1
acceptance_criteria: Inspect/create/branch/modify/render/verify/commit completes without GUI or Blender.
Three lighting/material variants preserve the protected geometry digest.
Budgets, retries, disconnects, event resumption and conflicts pass fault tests.
Independent supported clients pass the proposed narrow ABI v1 contract.
Local browser save/export/recovery works under the published profile.
exclusions: No stable version of every future domain operation
milestones.estimate_policy: Estimate only after relevant prototype and staffing evidence.
milestones.completion_scope: Trusted local static Lambertian scene workflow, three restricted variants, native durable jobs and selection, browser GPU/OPFS recovery, narrow ABI v1 with Python and C clients. Transient branches, no remote tenants or durable browser job worker.

All operators specify degeneracy, attribute-transfer and topology-correspondence behavior.
Field/node execution and equivalent direct operations agree for supported semantics.
Procedural assets survive native save/reload.
Geometry growth and local/wide edit amplification are measured.
